title: v0.1.0 Initial public release
description: Go service with the provider interface and its fake, OpenTofu infrastructure, CI without apply, security tooling, documentation. No open issue: everything is in the initial commit.

title: v0.2.0 Go upgrade and tooling baseline
description: Keep the Go toolchain, the pinned dev tools and the CI actions current, and prove the CI on real runners (Linux, macOS, Windows).

title: v0.3.0 Testability and offline demo
description: A contract test shared by every provider, and a demo that stays offline and deterministic.

title: v0.4.0 API hardening
description: Pagination, a short cache in front of the Cloud Run Admin API, request correlation in the logs, and an OpenAPI description checked by tests.

title: v0.5.0 Container hardening
description: Signed image with SBOM and provenance, and a reviewed policy for scan exceptions.

title: v0.6.0 OpenTofu infrastructure
description: A written deployment runbook and the identity model for the manual deployment, with the plan check before every apply.

title: v0.7.0 CI/CD without apply
description: Decide and, if accepted, add a read-only drift check in CI, without ever applying from a pipeline.

title: v0.8.0 Docs and registry link
description: Project page on paulperigault.fr, registry entry and README validated by the owner.

title: v1.0.0 Stable API
description: Freeze the /api/v1 contract with a schema, a compatibility test and a deprecation policy.
